bundle.shortDescription: A ghost lives at the top of your screen
bundle.longDescription: Fedo puts a ghost at the top of your GNOME top bar: it shows your Claude Code and Antigravity sessions, and lets you approve, answer, chat and drop files without leaving what you are doing.
